svg.title: V-03 · FlowState: Video analytics for machines that may not call home. A FastAPI engine runs fifteen detectors across up to six cameras and fuses them into one 0 to 100 threat index, under an Electron and React console. A missing model greys out one detector with the reason named, never the console. Ships air-gapped, with its own Python runtime and bundled weights. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Electron, React, YOLO, ONNX Runtime, OpenCV, PyTorch, SQLite.
